classes.name: HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)
classes.description: Emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil (Truvada and generics), emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (Descovy), cabotegravir LA (Apretude), lenacapavir (Yeztugo).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill or long-acting shot that prevents HIV.

classes.name: Single-tablet HIV treatment regimens
classes.description: Complete single-tablet regimens: bictegravir/FTC/TAF (Biktarvy), dolutegravir/abacavir/lamivudine (Triumeq), dolutegravir/lamivudine (Dovato), dolutegravir/rilpivirine (Juluca), darunavir/cobicistat/FTC/TAF (Symtuza), elvitegravir/cobi/FTC/TAF (Genvoya), rilpivirine/FTC/TAF (Odefsey), efavirenz/FTC/TDF and generics; cabotegravir/rilpivirine LA (Cabenuva).
classes.plainDescription: A once-a-day pill that treats HIV.

records.verificationNote: Read from PDF p.20. Generic emtricitabine-tenofovir DF 200-300 mg is Tier 4, QL 30 tablets per 30 days, no PA, and is the lowest-barrier covered PrEP tablet. Descovy is Tier 5 and is the alternative. Apretude (cabotegravir long-acting) is provider-administered and would normally fall under the medical benefit (may be Part B). Yeztugo (lenacapavir) was not located in the text layer; Sunlenca on PDF p.24 is listed for a different indication and is not a PrEP alternative. The document does not say its list is complete, so neither is called nonformulary. Sig is standard label dosing. [Reused: same national Wellcare Value Script PDP formulary 26195 as IL (reused, checked)]

records.verificationNote: Read from PDF p.19-24 (Antivirals). Biktarvy is Tier 5 with no PA or QL printed. It is the most commonly prescribed single-tablet regimen here and is the guideline-preferred choice for most adults. Picked over the generic efavirenz-emtricitabine-tenofovir DF (Tier 4), because efavirenz-based single-tablet regimens are no longer first-line; that tier advantage is recorded as the first alternative. Cabenuva (cabotegravir-rilpivirine) is provider-administered and would normally fall under the medical benefit (may be Part B); it was not located in the text layer. The document does not say its list is complete, so no alternative is called nonformulary. Sig is standard label dosing. [Reused: same national Wellcare Value Script PDP formulary 26195 as IL (reused, checked)]
